summary: iter193 review — Backend pytest (test_iter191_pending_badges.py + test_iter192_cash_provinces.py) = 10/10 passing. Frontend mobile withdrawal detail dialog INITIALLY CRASHED with ReferenceError: wrap is not defined in CopyableText.jsx (main agent added <CopyableText wrap={true} .../> usage but forgot to destructure the `wrap` prop). Admin sidebar badges render '99+' with title '2488 pendientes' (orders) and '1445 pendientes' (withdrawals); reconciliation badge correctly absent (manual_review=0). AdminOverview cash-provinces-block renders 16 checkbox toggles and toggling Pinar del Río unchecked it client-side.

rca of the issue: RCA: iter191/192 added a new `wrap` prop to CopyableText and used it in the className expression (line 60), but did not add `wrap` to the destructured prop list (lines 17-24). Result: at mount time JS evaluates a bare identifier `wrap`, throws ReferenceError, React ErrorBoundary catches it and shows the fallback UI. Reproduction: open /dashboard/vip on 390x844, open Account History → Withdrawals tab, click any withdrawal-row-* — dialog fails to render. Mitigation applied: add `wrap = false` to CopyableText prop destructure so undefined callers still get the truncate behaviour and callers passing wrap={true} get the wrap layout.
